CMAQ BUTADIENE13/ACROLEIN are no-feedback toxics tracers, so acrolein is represented by ISPD (the CB6 unsaturated carbonyl lump, whose photolysis already uses acrolein cross sections), scaled to conserve carbon (3/4)
higher aldehydes (C3-C7): average C5 = ALDX + 3 PAR
aromatic ring + one carbon: TOL (7 C); no explicit mapping found
methyl formate: ester carbon is unreactive (UNR, not a CB6r5 model species) -> 1 PAR; cf. methyl acetate = 2 PAR + UNR
